Entries.Original: Today marks the final day of training for Phase Two. Your objective is to reach Point Gamma.
A large Cancer swarm lies ahead. You may need to reevaluate your tactics if you wish to make it through unscathed.
She's right... Aoi, you think we can make it with how we've been working together?
If we continue improving at our current rate, it might be possible...but not within the given time frame.
Yeah... I think we need to optimize things a bit.
Optimize?
When a swarm attacks, your squad has been drawing the attention of some of the Cancers for us.
But there's a small gap before you actually open fire.
Yes. It's so your squad has time to retreat to safety first.
Let's get rid of that part. When we call for backup, just fire away.
I like the sound of that. Sure.
Just follow our instincts, meow.
Beautiful disaster, here we come!
P-Please! Don't say that!
I won't have it! It's too risky!
It's fine. We'll already know where you're aiming.
But... I...
What do you say, squad?
No complaints here. Even if we enter the line of fire, all we need to do is pay attention and dodge any incoming bullets.
Yeah, but they ain't gonna hit us. I trust 'em.
Kayamori. What will it be?
The squad's on board.
Then it's final—no delays.
Yes, ma'am! Our attacks will land true!

This will surely be difficult, but I have faith in your ability to accomplish the task at hand.
